Sapling is live. The final Zcash launchpad on Solana.

STAMP proved Zcash can carry a record of a burn. you destroy a token, you get a receipt.

we built what it could have been: you burn, you get paid, and then you get the receipt/stamp on Zcash mainnet.

every coin planted on Sapling is a pump.fun coin, paired with ZEC instead of SOL. same curve, same graduation, same terminals. one difference: every coin has roots.

the roots are a vault of ZEC under the coin. every trade feeds it: at least 0.50% of every trade, in ZEC. that floor is written into the program.

burn the token on solana in one transaction. your share of the roots comes back in ZEC, in the same transaction.

roots × your tokens ÷ supply. no claim, no wait.

add a zcash address and a stamp lands on zcash mainnet, cut with exactly what you destroyed and exactly what the roots paid you. one-way, verifiable, and held by nobody but you.

a stamp tells the world what you burned. Sapling pays you for it first.

Zcash can't hold memecoins yet. it can hold proof. a stamp is a record, not a token.

Crypto Investors Horrified After Memecoin Launchpad Introduces Concept Of Financial Consequences

SOLANA — Panic spread across cryptocurrency markets after developers unveiled Sapling ($SAPLING), a Zcash-powered memecoin launchpad that allows traders to create speculative assets while accumulating actual reserves.

“This is an existential threat to our industry,” explained one investor. “For years, we’ve perfected the art of launching thousands of coins backed by absolutely nothing. Now these lunatics want collateral?”

Sapling allows newly launched tokens to accumulate ZEC reserves from trading fees, creating a system where holders can burn their tokens to redeem a proportional share of accumulated assets.

Analysts described the development as particularly concerning because it introduces an unfamiliar concept to cryptocurrency markets: something potentially remaining after everyone stops believing in it.

Even worse, trading fees can fund SAPLING buybacks and burns, directly linking launchpad activity to token scarcity.

“First they introduce reserves, then redemptions, and next they’ll expect us to understand balance sheets,” warned one trader.

Industry experts fear Sapling could become a serious competitor to Pump.fun by combining speculative token launches with Zcash-backed economics.

Developers have reportedly been urged to immediately discontinue the redemption mechanism and replace it with an AI agent that tweets inspirational quotes.

At press time, investors were demanding that Sapling abandon its financial infrastructure and launch a frog-themed token instead.

Crypto Investors Outraged After Startup Makes Tokenized Stocks Understandable Without Requiring 17 Browser Tabs

ROBINHOOD CHAIN — Cryptocurrency investors expressed widespread alarm after discovering that Prism Assets ($PRISM) is building an actual platform for finding, analyzing, and trading tokenized real-world assets.

“This is incredibly irresponsible,” explained one investor. “I’ve spent years learning how to navigate six block explorers, three decentralized exchanges, and a Telegram group run by someone named LiquidityWizard69. Now these people want everything in one place?”

Prism offers wallet-based trading, asset indexes, liquidity analysis, reserve verification, and curated investment baskets, threatening the industry’s longstanding commitment to making simple financial transactions unnecessarily complicated.

Even more disturbing, the protocol offers PRISM staking, allowing holders to earn additional tokens after a 72-hour warm-up.

“First they give us a trading terminal, then on-chain verification, and now staking rewards,” warned one analyst. “At this rate, investors might start asking where those rewards actually come from.”

Industry experts are particularly concerned that Prism could become a convenient gateway to tokenized equities, potentially allowing ordinary investors to participate in financial markets without first developing a crippling addiction to blockchain explorers.

With PRISM recently trading around a $1.2 million valuation, analysts warn that widespread adoption could lead to the deeply unsettling prospect of investors evaluating actual usage instead of motivational posts.

Developers have reportedly been urged to discontinue the trading terminal immediately and replace it with an AI agent that predicts Bitcoin prices using astrology.

At press time, investors were demanding that Prism stop building infrastructure and announce a revolutionary new roadmap featuring the words institutional, quantum, and decentralized at least 40 times.
